title: Zesty Vietnamese Feta Noodles
description: A pungent and crumbly Vietnamese dish featuring feta, perfect for a post-workout meal, simmered to perfection in a ramekin, this shojin-friendly recipe is a great option for those looking for a flavorful and nutritious meal.

ingredients.name: feta cheese
ingredients.notes: preferably made from sheep's or goat's milk

instructions: In a large ramekin, combine the vegetable broth, soy sauce, grated ginger, and garlic, and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and let simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the cooked rice noodles to the ramekin and stir to combine.
Add the crumbled feta cheese to the ramekin and stir until the cheese is melted and the noodles are well coated.
Stir in the sesame oil and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the noodles to a serving bowl and top with thinly sliced green onions.
